name: Ant Directory

sources.title: Ant Directory homepage - tools directory with category/tag browsing
Pricing - Free $0 (180+ day wait, backlink maintenance) vs Listing $9.9 vs Featured $19.9
Submit page - requires Google or GitHub login

conditions: Free tier requires 'backlink maintenance' — you must keep a reciprocal backlink to Ant Directory live; paid tiers state 'no backlink required'
Free queue is extremely long: '180+ days wait at current pace', and free submissions 'may be rejected due to limited free slots'
Login (Google or GitHub) is required before the submit form renders
Paid: Listing $9.9 (immediate, ≥3 dofollow links) or Featured $19.9 (also 7 days at top of directory)
requirements: General tools directory (AI-heavy but categories include Business, Productivity, Development, Design, etc.)
Account required — Google or GitHub OAuth on /submit
Free tier: reciprocal backlink kept live (implied by 'backlink maintenance' vs paid 'no backlink required')
preparation: Product name, URL, description, category, tags, logo/screenshots
A page on your site for the reciprocal backlink (free tier)
Payment if choosing Listing ($9.9) or Featured ($19.9)
workflow: Go to https://antdirectory.com/submit and sign in with Google or GitHub
Choose the tier on https://antdirectory.com/pricing (Free / Listing $9.9 / Featured $19.9)
Complete the listing form with product details
Free: add the reciprocal backlink and wait 180+ days; Paid: 'list your product right now, no waiting'
Listing appears under /item/<slug> in category and tag pages
watchFor: The 'free' tier is effectively a link exchange AND a ~6-month queue — weak value unless patience is fine
Free slots are limited and 'may be rejected' — the free path is not a sure thing
Paid tiers promise '≥3 dofollow links' — the free tier's dofollow promise (3 links) is conditioned on backlink maintenance
OAuth-only login — no email signup visible
countsAsLive: A public item page exists at antdirectory.com/item/<slug> and appears in category/tag listings
unknowns: How backlink maintenance is verified on the free tier
Whether the catalog 'link=follow' holds on free listings (site says free includes '3 dofollow links' but conditioned on maintaining your backlink to them)
